options: A table listing temperatures by city
A graphical representation of objects at any specific location
A chart of CPU usage over time
A list of latitude values only
A database index for geographic data
questions.explanation: A Heat Map is a graphical representation of objects at any specific location, making complex data easy to visualise and understand briefly.

questions.stem: During the Covid-19 era, what were Heat Maps used to identify?
questions.explanation: Heat Maps were used to identify highly populated areas during the Covid-19 era.

questions.stem: How does Heat Map software know where a location is?
options: Users type in their postal address on every page
It guesses from the language of the web page
It reads the device's serial number
Latitude and longitude values picked up when a web page or app is opened are sent to databases, from which the software reads them
It uses the time zone setting of the computer
questions.explanation: When a web page or app is opened on a mobile or laptop, the location is picked up as latitude and longitude values, sent to databases and then picked up by the Heat Map software for graphical presentation.

options: Distance east or west of the prime meridian
Distance north or south of the Equator
questions.explanation: Latitude is the measurement of distance north or south of the Equator, using imaginary lines parallel to the Equator.

questions.stem: How many imaginary lines are used to measure Latitude?
questions.explanation: Latitude is measured with 180 imaginary lines that form circles around the Earth east to west, parallel to the Equator.

options: Distance north or south of the Equator
Distance east or west of the prime meridian
The speed of a moving object
questions.explanation: Longitude is the measurement east or west of the prime meridian.

questions.stem: What are the imaginary vertical lines that measure Longitude and meet at the North and South Poles called?
questions.explanation: The lines that run around the Earth vertically and meet at the poles are known as meridians; each measures one arc degree of longitude.

questions.stem: How many degrees does the distance around the Earth measure?
questions.explanation: The distance around the Earth measures 360 degrees, with each meridian measuring one arc degree of longitude.

questions.stem: With the introduction of Big Data and Data Lakes, which in-demand use case involving location is mentioned?
options: Analysing video and audio streams to identify unusual activities with location details
Storing postal codes in a spreadsheet
questions.explanation: One of the most in-demand use cases is to analyse video and audio streams to identify any unusual activities together with their location details.

questions.stem: In the Uber example, how do drivers use the Heat Map feature?
options: To rate passengers after each trip
To see where most taxis already are and where there are none, the latter being peak-hour areas where rates become high
questions.explanation: The driver side of the Uber app shows a Heat Map of where most taxis already are and where there are none; areas without taxis become peak-hour areas where rates become high.
